intro: Little Caesars is the value pizza chain famous for Hot-N-Ready pizzas you can grab without ordering ahead, the ExtraMostBestest with extra cheese and pepperoni, the square Deep! Deep! Dish, and the one-and-only Crazy Bread. It's built on low prices and speed. A classic pepperoni slice is about 270 calories and cheese is about 230. Below is the full Little Caesars menu with prices and calories for 2026 (large pizza prices shown).
quick_answer: A large Hot-N-Ready Classic pepperoni or cheese pizza at Little Caesars is about $6.99, the ExtraMostBestest is $7.99, and the Deep! Deep! Dish runs $8.99 to $9.49. Crazy Bread is $3.99 for 8, and 8 Caesar Wings are about $8.99. A classic pepperoni slice is about 270 calories.
hot_deal: Little Caesars value: the Hot-N-Ready Classic (about $6.99) is already the cheapest hot pizza in fast food, and combos like the Hot-N-Ready Classic Combo ($9.99, pizza plus Crazy Bread and a drink) stretch it further. The app adds coupons and free Crazy Bread offers. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a pizza at Little Caesars?
faqs.a: A large Hot-N-Ready Classic cheese or pepperoni pizza is about $6.99, the ExtraMostBestest is $7.99, and the Deep! Deep! Dish runs $8.99 to $9.49. Little Caesars is the cheapest of the big pizza chains.

faqs.q: What is Hot-N-Ready at Little Caesars?
faqs.a: Hot-N-Ready means the Classic pizzas are made fresh through the day and kept ready to grab, so you can walk in and leave with a pizza without ordering ahead or waiting. It is what Little Caesars is best known for.

Crazy Bread is Little Caesars' signature side: warm breadsticks brushed with garlic butter and topped with parmesan. An order of 8 is about $3.99, and each piece is roughly 100 calories. Add marinara with the Crazy Combo.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Little Caesars slice?
faqs.a: A classic pepperoni slice is about 270 calories and cheese is about 230. The square Deep! Deep! Dish is richer at about 320 calories per pepperoni slice.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Little Caesars?
faqs.a: The best known are the Hot-N-Ready Classic Pepperoni, the ExtraMostBestest, the Deep! Deep! Dish, Crazy Bread, and the Caesar Wings.
